## Description

Brief description of the changes proposed in this Pull Request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🆕 New Question / Answer added
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (link fixes, typo corrections, formatting)
- [ ] 💡 Code solution improvement (`code-solutions.md`)
- [ ] 📐 Diagram or design pattern addition (`diagrams.md` / `patterns.md`)
- [ ] 🛠️ Simulator or tooling enhancement (`simulator.html`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Question follows standard numbering and formatting rules.
- [ ] Difficulty tag (`⭐ Standard`, `⭐⭐ Hard`, `⭐⭐⭐ Principal`) is specified.
- [ ] Answer framework is concise, technical, and accurate.
- [ ] Verified that internal links work cleanly (`python3 scripts/validate_links.py`).
- [ ] `simulator.html` dataset updated if new questions were added.
